entities.name: Abu Abdallah Mohammed II Saadi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Abdallah Mohammed II, Al-Mutawakkil, often simply Abdallah Mohammed was the Sultan of Morocco from 1574 to 1576. He was the oldest son of Abdallah al-Ghalib and became Sultan after his father's death.
